description: This Kotlin file defines a singleton object PostPlaybackDeeplinkResolver that provides a method to ensure certain intent extras exist, assigning default values if they are missing. It is used to prepare intents for launching post-playback activities reliably.

classes.name: PostPlaybackDeeplinkResolver
classes.description: A singleton object providing utility functions to handle deep link intent extras for post-playback activities.

methods.name: resolveDefaultsIfMissing
methods.description: Checks the activity's intent for essential extras and injects default values if they are missing. Ensures the intent has all necessary information for post-playback operations.
